statement: Round03 fixed local development suite completes all six declared CM-target bins, subgroup bits5,45,71,125,224,260 and source bits7,47,73,127,226,262. Each bin has a compact integer model, prime-certificate arithmetic, an auxiliary full-order Frobenius candidate and four target-only Smart solves replayed by OpenSSL. In total42 source/42 target input checks,84 local projection checks,42 canonical-zero controls. Source-to-target outputs are zero. CM-to-Galois interpretation is a written conditional bridge; no independent execution proof, full formal proof, speed or transfer claim.
